name: Snowmobile
instructions: omr/instructions/42021-1-2.pdf (the snowmobile; book 1, 42021-1-1.pdf, builds the alternate one-ski snow scooter)

functions.does: Turning the handlebars steers both front skis: the steering column turns a short arm under the nose, which pushes two steering links out to the ski uprights.
functions.source: book: steps 1-12 (the front suspension and steering unit), 26-29

functions.does: Each ski rides on its own pair of wishbones (independent front suspension): pushing a ski up swings its upper and lower arms together and slides its shock absorber.
functions.source: book: steps 4-6 and 21-22 (the two grey shock absorbers)
functions.note: the arms on the other side stay put; each side works alone

functions.does: The two shock absorbers' springs hold the front up.
functions.skip: the springs only push back under the model's weight

functions.does: Each ski pivots on its mount, so its tip can tilt up and down over bumps.
functions.source: inferred: each ski hangs on a single pin through its bent cross block (sub 11 and sub 12); the book draws no arrow for it

functions.does: The track's four 20-tooth wheels turn freely, and the rubber-linked track runs round them.
functions.source: book: steps 1-9 of the track sub-build (before step 17)
functions.note: nothing drives the track; it only rolls

functions.does: The track unit is pinned to the body at two places and doesn't pivot.
functions.source: book: steps 17-19 (one pin in step 17, another in step 18, then two beams in step 19)
